output.population: 88 subjects: 36 with Alzheimer's disease, 23 with frontotemporal dementia, 29 healthy controls; group mean ages 63.6–67.9 years
output.summary: Resting-state eyes-closed EEG from people with Alzheimer's disease, frontotemporal dementia, and healthy subjects, recorded with 19 scalp electrodes at a hospital neurology department, with MMSE cognitive scores.
